title: Samsung Galaxy S25 Edge 512GB Offer Grabs Attention in Brazil
seoTitle: Samsung Galaxy S25 Edge 512GB Offer Hot in Brazil
subtitle: Price Below Four Thousand Reais Boosts Searches for Samsung's Ultra-Thin Model
excerpt: Magalu's promotion for the Galaxy S25 Edge 512GB, cutting the price by approximately R$777, has sparked significant interest among those seeking a premium smartphone.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
A significant price reduction at Magalu has put the Samsung Galaxy S25 Edge 512GB in the spotlight among consumers looking for top performance in an ultra-thin device.

Promotion Price and Conditions

The model is being sold for R$ 3,998.99 when paying via PIX, with free shipping. The initial price was R$ 4,776.66, and the total difference reaches approximately R$ 777, thanks to a R$ 300 discount with the coupon INFLU300 and an additional PIX payment markdown.

Design and Build Features

With a thickness of 5.8 mm and weighing 163 g, the Galaxy S25 Edge stands out for being much thinner and lighter than the Galaxy S25+. Its structure combines titanium, Gorilla Glass Ceramic 2 on the front, and IP68 certification, ensuring durability without compromising lightness.

Performance and Hardware

Equipped with the Snapdragon 8 Elite for Galaxy, 12 GB of RAM, and 512 GB of storage, the device offers power for demanding games, multitasking, and photo and video editing. The 6.7-inch Dynamic AMOLED 2X display features QHD+ resolution, an adaptive refresh rate of up to 120 Hz, HDR10+, and high brightness.

Battery Life and Charging

The 3,900 mAh battery is smaller than that of the Galaxy S25+, which has 4,900 mAh. Wired charging reaches 25 W, while the Plus model supports 45 W. It also supports 15 W wireless charging and reverse charging.

Cameras

The main 200 MP sensor with optical stabilization, combined with a 12 MP ultrawide, ensures detailed photos. The front camera has 12 MP. The model does not include a dedicated telephoto lens, a feature present in the Galaxy S25+.

With information from Canaltech, TNH1.
